newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Paul Cos rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Paul Cos rated a buy.

text.p: -- Wasserstein Perella analysts Myron Picoult and Al Capra said in a research note they initiated coverage of St. Paul Cos with a buy recommendation.
-- Earnings estimates are $5.55 per share for 1997 and $6.10 per share for 1998, they said.

"The key to our perspective is tied to some corporate divestitures, a continuation of an existing buyback program, and an interesting stock option program for many of the key operating executives. The dynamics of the situation, both operating and psychological, point to an upside potential of 50 percent to 60 percent over the next 18 to 24 months and downside risk of about 12 percent. This together with the current 2.7 percent yield seems to provide an interesting set of appreciation dynamics," the analysts wrote.
-- Shares were up 1/4 to 69-1/2 in early Friday NYSE trade.
